spans.s: ऊधस् [ūdhas], n. An udder (changed to ऊधन् in Bah. Comp. ऊधसो$नङ्
A covered secret place to which only friends are admitted.
The breast of a cattle. -Comp. -वती (a female, female animal) with full udders; Bhāg.
ऊधन्यम् [ūdhanyam], or ऊधस्यम् Milk (produced from the udder); ऊधस्यमिच्छामि तवोपभोक्तुम्
